This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="TFA" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|tan]] skin, elongated necks, and large, hairless craniums.<ref name="TFA" />

==Species in the galaxy==
During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire]], in [[5 BBY]], a member of this species visited the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]], dwelling within a local [[cantina|bar]] shortly before the [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation]] [[Pre-Mor Authority Security Forces|agent]] [[Syril Karn]] arrived.<ref name="Andor">{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}}</ref> Later, in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="TFA Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> another member of this species was present at [[Takodana Castle]] when the [[First Order]] destroyed the [[Hosnian system]] and invaded the planet [[Takodana]] in search of the [[droid]] [[BB-8]].<ref name="TFA" /> All members of this species are seen constantly smoking some sort of unique pipe.<ref name="Andor" /><ref name="TFA" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Unidentified-Species-Takodana-Concept.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Concept art by Luke Fisher]]
The species made their debut in the [[2016]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens]]'', directed by [[J.J. Abrams]].<ref name="TFA" /> They were designed by concept artist [[Luke Fisher]].<ref name="Art Book">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''</ref>
